outputs.explanation: Both the body weight plot and the LW/BW & FW/BW plot are scatter plots showing individual mouse data points with mean ± SD bars overlaid.
Panel B is a photograph (gross images), not a plot.
Panel C consists of micrographs (H&E and Oil Red O staining images), not plots.
Panel D is a dot blot/staining image, not a plot.
The 5mC/methylene blue quantification bar chart shows individual data points (dots) for each mouse overlaid on the bars.
The top part of panel F is a western blot (not a plot), but the bottom bar chart quantifying TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH shows individual data points (dots) overlaid on the bars.
